title: AI for Legal, Procurement, and Compliance

questions.question: What boundary should legal and procurement AI workflows preserve?
options: AI can prepare and structure work, but humans own interpretation, negotiation, and decisions
questions.explanation: AI support does not remove accountable legal or procurement review.

questions.question: Which signal is explicitly part of this lesson?
questions.explanation: Vendor clause is one of the review signals.

questions.question: What does the Python artifact produce?
options: A ranked legal/procurement review plan with controls and rationale
questions.explanation: The artifact structures review preparation; it is not a legal decision.

questions.question: Which control belongs to this lesson?
questions.explanation: A clause register keeps key terms traceable.

questions.question: When should legal or procurement AI work require a launch gate?
options: When obligation risk, confidential terms, or missing evidence create high impact
Only when the document is short
Only when no vendor is involved
Never; AI summaries are always safe
questions.explanation: High-risk generated review work needs explicit human review.

questions.question: What should vendor-term summaries remain linked to?
options: The source clauses and evidence used for the review
questions.explanation: Traceability protects legal and procurement decisions.
